item.title: Conan Town: The Home of Detective Conan — Guide
item.description: The town of Hokuei in central Tottori is the birthplace of Gosho Aoyama, creator of Detective Conan (Meitantei Conan), one of the best-selling and longest-running manga and anime series in Japan. The town has embraced its most famous export wholeheartedly, rebranding itself as ‘Conan Town’: from Conan Station, a themed street lined with bronze statues of the characters leads to the Gosho Aoyama Manga Factory, a museum devoted to the artist’s life and work with original art, interactive detective puzzles and displays.
